title: Fail-closed P1 owner and observation-map admission contract
objective: Encode the existing owner order and four-stage observation map as a machine-checkable admission state machine so that future source-owned packets can be resumed without silently promoting a comparator, a static fit, or a synthetic fixture.

layer_contract.question: Does the conclusion follow from the explicitly pinned hypotheses?
layer_contract.promotion_boundary: A contract check does not establish model identity or empirical truth.

layer_contract.question: Do the owner, dynamics, state, projection, observable, regulator and ordered map stages define one model?
layer_contract.promotion_boundary: A complete packet is still not a QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity or continuum identification.

layer_contract.question: Is the model mapped to known physical structures with an explicit error budget?
layer_contract.promotion_boundary: No physical identity is inferred by the admission predicate.

layer_contract.question: Does a frozen candidate predict unused data under an immutable scorer?
layer_contract.promotion_boundary: No score or holdout prediction is executed by this contract.

transitions.requires: nonempty source artifact hash and at least one owner slot
all nine ordered owner slots and a non-synthetic source hash
F_reg, F_lim, F_eff and F_obs are complete in order
complete packet is explicitly marked synthetic; this branch is test-only
candidate-neutral estimand, covariance, nuisance and immutable scorer are frozen
prospective holdout is hash-frozen and scored without retuning

admission_state_machine.synthetic_fixture_rule: A synthetic fixture may exercise transitions but can never enter SCORING_ADMITTED or PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATED.

admission_predicate.source_hash: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 and nonempty source path are required
admission_predicate.owner_slots: all nine ordered slots must be present and true
admission_predicate.map_stages: F_reg, F_lim, F_eff and F_obs must be true in order
admission_predicate.holdout: prospective holdout and immutable scorer must be frozen before scoring
admission_predicate.synthetic: synthetic or fixture packets are contract-test-only
admission_predicate.missing_stage_rule: a missing earlier stage blocks every later stage

fixture_policy.complete_synthetic: must reach CONTRACT_TEST_ONLY_COMPLETE and never production admission

assumptions: The exact R-449, T-059 and R-470 authorities remain the controlling owner and method boundaries.
A source hash identifies an artifact but does not by itself establish physical identity.
The nine owner slots and four ordered map stages are the existing T-054/T-059/T-061 contract, not a new research method.
A machine-checkable fail-closed predicate is useful for resumability even when no source owner is currently available.
Lean checks only the Boolean admission firewall and does not supply a source owner or empirical evidence.
missing_assumptions: A versioned source-owned generator or transfer, state, physical projection and time boundary.
The five R-192 production proof-owner slots: heat-root incidence, filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current intertwiner and one-use q ledger.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, covariance, nuisance model, scorer and prospective holdout.
Uniform regulator, volume, exhaustion, phase and beta estimates and a physical QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity correspondence.
evidence_level: T0 / MACHINE-CHECKED MODEL-CONSISTENCY ADMISSION FIREWALL WITH PRIMARY, INDEPENDENT, HOSTILE, INTEGRATED AND LEAN TESTS
non_claims: No source-owned dynamics or observation map is admitted by this result.
Synthetic fixtures test only the contract and cannot become candidates or scores.
No finite mobility table, physical-empty sign, Reading-H stationarity, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity, continuum, cosmic-origin or mass-gap conclusion follows.
Existing T-054 forward and T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order, stopped-loop rules and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
hostile_tests: swap or delete one owner slot
mark a synthetic fixture as production
set F_lim true while F_reg is false
skip F_eff and set F_obs true
freeze a holdout without an immutable scorer
admit a source path with a malformed digest
promote the contract-test fixture to a prospective result
boundary: R-471 is an additive T0 contract result. It makes the existing owner and inverse-map admission boundary executable and fail-closed; it does not create an owner artifact, choose a dynamics, score observations, or alter any established proof method.
next_action: Keep the current state EMPTY_OWNER_ARTIFACT. Request the versioned physical-owner validity/interpolation, common-time-standard, detector-to-geocenter and timing-uncertainty packet for T-061, while resuming the unchanged T-054 owner-level Q3LOCK queue. Admit no scoring until a real non-synthetic owner packet fills all slots and all four map stages in order.
